governing_questions.q: Q1. Does the Schrodinger equation accept d369?
governing_questions.a: NO. G14 has det=0, rank=6, is non-invertible. No Hermitian H_Q exists such that G14=exp(-iH). Exp 36 confirms with mean error 70.6%.

governing_questions.q: Q2. What is the correct mathematical framework?
governing_questions.a: Open Markov Dynamics / Lindblad CPTP map. G14 is a column-stochastic transition matrix with absorbing subspace {3,6,9} and transient states {1,2,4,5,7,8}. Steady state: 77.8% on {3,6,9} (Exp 39).

governing_questions.q: Q3. What is the dynamical status of {3,6,9}?
governing_questions.a: Three roles simultaneously: (1) Absorbing states of Markov chain, (2) Decoherence-Free Subspace of Lindblad dynamics, (3) Zero modes of discrete Dirac operator (Exp 42, mass gap=0.75).

governing_questions.q: Q4. What is the entropy signature of the Quran?
governing_questions.a: Maximum entropy base: H_norm=0.9948 (99.48% of theoretical maximum). Near-perfectly uniform digit-root distribution, combined with systematic +4.9pp bias toward {3,6,9}. Unique among tested Arabic texts.

governing_questions.q: Q5. Is the Quran distribution statistically distinct?
governing_questions.a: YES. Exp 34: proj(Quran)=38.1% vs Bukhari 30.4%, Muallaqat 28.2%, Futuhat 34.7%, all p<0.001. Exp 41: Quran has highest Shannon entropy vs all controls (Cliffs d=0.71 vs Bukhari, p~0).
